changes.text: Fixed rare crash bug that prevented some characters from logging on.
Blaster attacks (primary and secondary) with multiple damage types were inadvertently doing too much damage (up to 50% more!) in PvP after the irresistible damage change. This has been corrected.
Power sets affected by the Blaster fix include Archery, Energy Blast, Fire Blast, Ice Blast, Sonic Attack, Electricity Manipulation, Energy Manipulation, Fire Manipulation, Ice Manipulation
The Abyss – Fixed hole in the zone that allowed players to get under the game world.
